abstract: Autoscale LLM serving pods on Kubernetes with KEDA: ScaledObject and TriggerAuthentication on vLLM queue depth, KV-cache pressure, work queues and GPU metrics. Covers install, trigger queries and thresholds, HPA behavior, fallback, scale to zero and the HTTP add-on, authentication including the 2.21 token-audience change, upgrades, troubleshooting and combos with vLLM, the GPU operator, the inference gateway and Ray Serve. Verified against KEDA v2.21.0.
